notes: g2rd-format-arms writes the §2002:14.8.29.1 READ arms PREVIOUS, INTO, AT END and NOT AT END, INVALID KEY and NOT INVALID KEY, WITH LOCK and WITH NO LOCK, ADVANCING ON LOCK, IGNORING LOCK, the format 1 retry-phrase, and KEY IS with both data-name-1 and record-key-name-1. The records it selects follow §2002:14.8.29.3 GR12, GR18, GR21, GR27 and GR29, and it printed the ten derived lines at --std 2002 on the pinned build. pb331_read_lock_brackets covers the lock brackets and the format 2 RETRY.
